- NUMBER: Numeric string (e.g. "42", "3.14"). Stored as-is.
- LOCATION: Any string (e.g. a location name or ID)
- HIDDEN: Any string
- PERSON: A valid long user/person ID as string (e.g. "12345"). Send null, "", or "0" to clear.
